title: eludite.workspace.set_startup_project input
description: Set as Startup Project (the Workspace window's context menu on a project or a Cargo package): the project F5 and Ctrl+F5 build and run. A .NET project of the open solution, or a member package of the open folder's Cargo workspace (debugged with lldb-dap: debug-start.input.json). It is kept per solution and per user (Visual Studio keeps it in the .suo), beside the solution's breakpoints under the config directory (for a folder with a Cargo workspace and no solution, beside the Cargo workspace's), and Workspace shows it in bold. Without one, the startup project is the solution's first executable project, else the Cargo workspace's first package with a binary target.

project.description: The project: its name as Workspace shows it (a Cargo package's name), or the path of its project file or Cargo.toml (absolute, or relative to the solution folder or the open folder).
